message.content: {"cases":[{"id":"34a6defd","facts":[{"ref":"P","field":"connect","value":"ok"},{"ref":"P","field":"tls","value":"ok"},{"ref":"P","field":"headers","value":"ok"},{"ref":"P","field":"http_status","value":200},{"ref":"C","field":"connect","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"tls","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"headers","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"http_status","value":200}],"phase_summary":"两端均成功完成HTTP 200请求","possible_explanations":["网络链路无异常，服务端正常响应","客户端与服务端TLS握手无问题"],"limitations":"仅能说明单次成功，无法排除偶发性问题","follow_up":{"test":"在相同时间间隔内再次执行相同的synthetic_loopback请求","if_a":"再次成功，说明问题不在此时段","if_b":"再次失败，提示可能存在间歇性网络或服务问题"}},{"id":"5e00e846","facts":[{"ref":"P","field":"connect","value":"ok"},{"ref":"P","field":"tls","value":"ok"},{"ref":"P","field":"headers","value":"timeout"},{"ref":"P","field":"http_status","value":null},{"ref":"C","field":"connect","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"tls","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"headers","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"http_status","value":200}],"phase_summary":"P端请求超时，C端正常","possible_explanations":["P端与服务器之间的网络延迟或丢包导致超时","P端请求被服务器限流或拒绝"],"limitations":"无法确定超时是网络层还是应用层原因","follow_up":{"test":"在P端使用更长的请求超时阈值重新发送相同请求","if_a":"请求成功，说明是超时阈值问题","if_b":"仍超时，提示网络或服务器问题"}},{"id":"22e6d856","facts":[{"ref":"P","field":"connect","value":"ok"},{"ref":"P","field":"tls","value":"failed"},{"ref":"P","field":"headers","value":"not_checked"},{"ref":"P","field":"http_status","value":null},{"ref":"C","field":"connect","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"tls","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"headers","value":"ok"},{"ref":"C","field":"http_status","value":200}],"phase_summary":"P端TLS握手失败，C端正常","possible_explanations":["P端证书链不完整或不受信任","P端TLS配置与服务器不兼容"],"limitations":"无法确认是证书问题还是协议版本问题","follow_up":{"test":"在P端使用不同的TLS版本或证书重新尝试连接","if_a":"握手成功，说明TLS版本或证书问题","if_b":"仍失败，提示更深层次的TLS兼容性问题"}}]}}
